after.text:
Freezing. We insure for loss caused by freezing of a plumbing, heating, air conditioning or automatic fire protective sprinkler system or of a household appliance only if, while the dwelling is vacant, unoccupied or being constructed, you used reasonable care to maintain heat in the building or to shut off the water supply and drain all systems and appliances of water.

This peril includes the water damage that follows when a frozen pipe, fitting or appliance cracks or bursts, and the cost of tearing out and replacing any part of the building needed to repair the system, but not the system itself.

after.text: We do not insure liability for damage to silverware caused by governmental action unless it is located on the residence premises. The most we will pay for liability for damage to silverware under this provision is $2,500 for any one loss. If governmental action and a covered peril both contribute to the loss, we pay only for the part caused by the covered peril. This provision does not reduce the limit of liability shown for Coverage A.

examples.text:
Insured means you and residents of your household who are your relatives or other persons under the age of 21 in your care.

Residence premises means the one family dwelling where you reside, shown as the residence premises in the Declarations.

Occurrence means an accident, including continuous or repeated exposure to substantially the same general harmful conditions.

Actual cash value means the cost to replace damaged property with new property of like kind and quality, less depreciation for age, condition and obsolescence.
